paragraphs.text: The Urhaalan Valley was an area in northwestern Terisiare during the Dark Age of Dominaria .

It was located near the edge of the Colekgan Mountains , across a wide flat plain from the Eln Forest , about a week's travel from the fishing village of Shingol , and 500 miles due west of Ronom Glacier , with the straits of Lat-Nam further south down the coast. The Urhaalan Valley was populated by goblins , and a tribe of minotaurs that shared its name. The Urhaalan minotaurs were divided into clans, like Utyeehn, Helmhein, and Faasir, and houses like Mytaarun.

During the Dark Age , the minotaurs of Urhaalan Valley came into conflict with the elves of Eln Forest through the schemes of the sorceress Sacumon . This escalated into an all-out war, which decimated the population of the Urhaalan minotaurs, eradicating both the Helmhein and Faasir clans. Individuals killed in this war included Mehonvo , Adterlo , Padarno and Mytaru . The essence of the legendary hero Tiyint was also awakened into a stone colossus and brought into the war on the side of the Urhaalan but eventually turned on them until its deactivation.
During the onset of the Ice Age , Urhaalan Valley was slowly covered and destroyed by the widening Great Glacier .
